chapters.title: Seeing the Site
chapters.outcome: Identify the device behind a work order and explain the evidence for its name.
chapters.consequence: Without this, a familiar name on a work order still does not tell you which device to touch.

chapters.title: Choosing Evidence
chapters.outcome: Establish source, authorization, collection boundary and freshness.
chapters.consequence: Without this, you cannot say where the evidence came from, who authorised it, or when it stopped being current.

chapters.title: Reading the Inventory
chapters.outcome: Find and export the inventory records that need attention.
chapters.consequence: Without this, a crowded inventory hides the small set of records actually worth discussing.

chapters.title: Making the Next Decision
chapters.outcome: Give the next review question an owner and a recorded basis.
chapters.consequence: Without this, the meeting ends with agreement and no owner for the next question.

chapters.title: Software and Vulnerability Review
chapters.outcome: Prepare a supplier or engineering question from software and cryptographic evidence.
chapters.consequence: Without this, you ask a supplier the wrong question and wait a fortnight to find out.

chapters.title: Attack Route Evidence
chapters.outcome: Read each route as evidence and assumptions requiring review.
chapters.consequence: Without this, a diagram that looks like a route gets treated as one.

chapters.title: Cryptographic Planning
chapters.outcome: Estimate migration timing and assign cryptographic work to owners.
chapters.consequence: Without this, you cannot state how long your own migration would take — the number the whole programme depends on.

chapters.title: Rehearsing Decisions
chapters.outcome: Use a bounded model to challenge a proposed change before production.
chapters.consequence: Without this, the first time you learn what a change breaks is in production.

chapters.title: Governing the Next Step
chapters.outcome: Distinguish planning and authorization from executed work.
chapters.consequence: Without this, "not executed" looks like failure rather than the control working.

chapters.title: Asking Secure with Context
chapters.outcome: Use cited assistant answers within the available evidence.
chapters.consequence: Without this, an assistant's answer travels further than the evidence behind it.

chapters.title: Carrying Evidence Forward
chapters.outcome: Preserve the evidence and decision for later review.
chapters.consequence: Without this, the evidence stops being useful the moment the meeting ends.

chapters.title: Operating with Confidence
chapters.outcome: Verify the run and its coverage after checking collector health.
chapters.consequence: Without this, a green service check is mistaken for a completed collection.

chapters.title: Showing the Value
chapters.outcome: Prepare a handoff with an owner, evidence and a clear question.
chapters.consequence: Without this, the handoff arrives without the owner, the evidence or the question.

chapters.title: Bringing the Decision Together
chapters.outcome: Connect the local exercise to a scoped real-world next step.
chapters.consequence: Without this, local practice never becomes a record the organisation can act on.

chapters.title: The decision
chapters.outcome: Frame the release question around inspectable evidence.
chapters.consequence: Without this, the release decision is made on a badge colour.

chapters.title: Source and scope
chapters.outcome: Bind the review to one authorized source snapshot.
chapters.consequence: Without this, two reviewers examine two different versions of the same code.

chapters.title: Evidence
chapters.outcome: Check the cited source and distinguish confirmation, refutation and uncertainty.
chapters.consequence: Without this, nobody can tell whether the finding reproduces or was never real.

chapters.title: Attack paths
chapters.outcome: Separate a possible route from demonstrated runtime behavior.
chapters.consequence: Without this, a possible route and a demonstrated one look identical in the report.

chapters.title: Models and limits
chapters.outcome: Turn missing relationships into explicit review tasks.
chapters.consequence: Without this, a missing relationship is read as an absence of risk.

chapters.title: Software and cryptography
chapters.outcome: Understand the role of a component or cryptographic use.
chapters.consequence: Without this, you know the algorithm's name and nothing about the key's job.

chapters.title: People and decisions
chapters.outcome: Record a decision and a reason the next reviewer can retrieve.
chapters.consequence: Without this, the reason for a decision is lost by the next release.

chapters.title: Remediation
chapters.outcome: Prepare the proposed fix, side effects, verification and recovery.
chapters.consequence: Without this, a fix is approved with no statement of what it could break or how to get back.

chapters.title: Delivery and history
chapters.outcome: Compare review states and explain changes without assuming a fix.
chapters.consequence: Without this, nobody can say what changed between this review and the last.

chapters.title: Implementation
chapters.outcome: Agree the deployment, access and analysis boundary.
chapters.consequence: Without this, the analysis boundary is discovered during an incident.

chapters.title: Daily operation
chapters.outcome: Check source, completion, coverage and recoverability in daily use.
chapters.consequence: Without this, the first ten minutes go on working out whether the screen is telling the truth.

chapters.title: Evaluation
chapters.outcome: Evaluate reproducible cases and review effort against a fair baseline.
chapters.consequence: Without this, you are comparing tools on a demonstration rather than on your own code.

chapters.title: The Decision Behind the Alert
chapters.outcome: Give an urgent signal an investigation question and owner.
chapters.consequence: Without this, the alert is urgent and the decision is still nobody's.

chapters.title: Evidence Worth Acting On
chapters.outcome: Reconcile a result with its inputs, time and assumptions.
chapters.consequence: Without this, the same number means two different things to two people on the same call.

chapters.title: Discovery and Investigation
chapters.outcome: Use estate context to choose the next useful check.
chapters.consequence: Without this, the investigation starts with a host list instead of a question.

chapters.title: Attack Paths and Consequence
chapters.outcome: Review candidate routes without treating rank as breach probability.
chapters.consequence: Without this, a ranked route is mistaken for a probability of compromise.

chapters.title: Digital Twins and Better Rehearsals
chapters.outcome: Use rehearsal to test the decision and its recovery assumptions.
chapters.consequence: Without this, the rehearsal proves the diagram rather than the decision.

chapters.title: Live Operations and Replay
chapters.outcome: Give the next analyst the same input window and provenance.
chapters.consequence: Without this, the second analyst cannot see the same window as the first.

chapters.title: The SOC and the Hunt
chapters.outcome: Bound the hunt with a question, time budget and stopping condition.
chapters.consequence: Without this, the hunt extends until someone gets tired rather than until the clock says stop.

chapters.title: IT Operations with a Change Owner
chapters.outcome: Prepare an operational proposal the service owner can assess.
chapters.consequence: Without this, the change is approved by someone who cannot say what the service tolerates.

chapters.title: Authority, Verification and Recovery
chapters.outcome: Verify authority on the selected path and recheck the result after action.
chapters.consequence: Without this, authority is a label rather than a scope with an expiry and a way back.

chapters.title: Architecture and Deployment Choices
chapters.outcome: Choose and verify inference, connectivity, access and recovery arrangements.
chapters.consequence: Without this, "it runs locally" is believed rather than tested.

chapters.title: A Pilot That Earns Its Place
chapters.outcome: Measure a bounded workflow and record the adoption decision.
chapters.consequence: Without this, the pilot proves the calendar rather than the capability.

chapters.title: The Executive Field Guide
chapters.outcome: Produce a concise handoff with evidence, uncertainty and the next owner.
chapters.consequence: Without this, good analysis sits unread in a queue.
